name: 陳岡伯
objective: This course aims to enhance students’ speaking skills with a particular focus on listening comprehension, critical analysis of certain issues, organization of ideas, and lucid delivery of a speech. The course is designed thematically and divided into 4 teaching sections. Each section contains two weeks. In the first week, we will approach a specific issue by watching an introductory video clip, doing listening exercises and understanding key terms. And then students will be divided into groups to discuss and present their opinions regarding the issue. In the second week, we will further explore the issue by watching selected scenes from a relevant film. Each group will be asked to answer critical questions by analyzing the scenes, formulate and organize their ideas, and deliver a short speech at the end of the class.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Introduction

Unit 1: Moral dilemma
Week 2: Listening comprehension and discussion: the trolley problem
Week 3: Film analysis and discussion: Scent of a Woman (1992)

Week 4: National holiday

Unit 2: Hero in popular culture
Week 5: Listening and comprehension: tragic hero
Week 6: Film analysis and discussion: The Dark Knight (2008)

Week 7: Film viewing: Se7en (1995)
Week 8: National holiday
Week 9, 11: Mid-term group presentation

Unit 3: Rethinking evil
Week 12: Listening and comprehension: banality of evil
Week 13: Film analysis and discussion: A Few Good Men (1992)

Unit 4: Cross-cultural encounter
Week 14: Listening comprehension and discussion: cultural appropriation
Week 15: Film analysis and discussion: Pocahontas (1995)

Week 16: Film viewing: Get Out (2017)
Week 17-18: Final group presentation
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Students will watch Jordan Peele's Get Out (2017) in Week 16, and then each group will be assigned a specific topic to do a research on the film in Week 17 and present the results in Week 18.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          8
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Each group will produce slides and present the results of their study on the film to the instructor.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          This presentation accounts for 30% of the final grade.
